repos_data.description: Stop renting your intelligence. Own it with AnythingLLM. Everything you need for a powerful local-first agent experience

mu (μ): most of what a coding agent decides isn't code. mu hands 40 kinds of yes/no calls to a small model: fewer wasted tokens, fewer approvals on autopilot, fewer runs that stop halfway. Built on pi.
Define a Go struct. Get a CLI that an agent can discover, call, sandbox, and debug. Flags, env vars, config files, validation, JSON Schema, MCP, structured errors, and WASM. Built on Cobra.
Agent-native harness for quantitative research: develop plugins, run traceable experiments, and inspect results via CLI, HTTP, MCP, and Studio.
